test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
By folding the given paper, which of the following box can be made?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81db1b315c38c85cf94a12ffc55106423a76cbb97a44570c16696223bb1d20e8.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c30cb063c1307506e1ad389c6903caa9b53f1159868c7b1e7d2db59ef6694ab.png] 

B and A is the opposite sides.

C and 2 is the opposite sides.

8 and 9 is the opposite sides.

And, two opposite sides can not be the adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shows in a dice.

Now,

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88ef732c13fdeb107cae6af348a0bf5822b3d2fee3c2592c1c214f33c1bfd8d7.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are adjacent sides.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45b999dbb5c87b74389f069a64cbe15ff7a9a3c2a28114fa55f61b230a3dca78.png] → Can not be made, because 8 and 9 is the opposite sides.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/619d019316fe20f812cd9b4de3fef9cb46e10c286ed5c6154c6aba29579d9fce.png] → Can not be made, because A and B is the opposite sides

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9a7d31840dbd5f2519e88e6dfa175a9e3a19c8c81ed064c7f94224905f47945.png] → Can not be made, because C and 2 is the opposite sides.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
